Photo 1: Same drum from a slightly different angle. The label is clear, with the same text and hazard symbols. The drum appears to be outdoors, with wet surface and some rust on the metal rim.
Photo 2: Two blue drums side by side, both with the same label. The drums are dirty, with visible rust and debris. The label is intact on both. The background shows a building and metal structure.

Photo 3: Close-up of one drum's label. The label is clear, with the same text and hazard symbols. The bottom of the drum has a plastic wrap, and the date 'MANU DATE: 02/2025' is visible. The label includes emergency contact information and manufacturer details.
